claims.claim: Reviewers mention that this version features historical campaigns, widescreen support, and water bump mapping while keeping the original UI and soundtrack style.

citations.review_text:
After playing through the rest of the AoE library of remakes, I've come to appreciate the "HD" edition a lot more. It's JUST AoE2 with some widescreen support and water bump mapping, I guess. No soulless modern UI, no "remastered" soundtrack. Just the experience you truly remember.

While I mechanically find AoE2 utterly unbearable, it's a staple of the early 00's RTS genre, and I respect that, and if you want the ORIGINAL experience, this is as close as it's gonna get on modern hardware.

This was probably my first history-based game that I truly loved, right next to Civilization. It’s the ultimate nostalgia trip, and I still find myself coming back to it even now with all the new content they keep releasing. It’s one of those rare games that never really feels "finished" for me.

[The Breakdown]
Graphics: Classic 2D style
Gameplay: Addictive and perfectly balanced
Story: Great historical campaigns
Difficulty: Hard to master
Grind: None
Worth the price? Yes
Rating: 10/10

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game includes added campaigns featuring civilizations such as the Goths, Indians, and Spanish.

citations.review_text:
I prefer this version rather than the Definitive Edition, for the graphic design and sounds. I don't need the additional content of the newer versions and HD Edition keeps the original style of the game, and it's not a problem. Civs are just what it has to be. Sub "regional" civs as I call them have no place in this game. :D
One downside however is the new campaigns. I regretted not to have one with turks, persians, british, vikings, chinese, japanese, mayans or korean... Those are the civs I would have like to play a campaign with. It's a shame not to have even one of them. Instead we have the boring goths and indians and another one with the spanish ; I like this civ but why 2 campaigns with the same civ when others don't have any?! -_- Plus, the pictures accompanying new campaigns are in bad taste and the writings try to imitate the same style as in the older campaigns but the texts are too long and the nostalgic style lacks authenticity.

It's a truley brilliant game, I used to play this as a kid, it's exactly the same, though it is in hd, it's still as it is, it also has some new featurers and new dlc that let's you do newer campaigns, I would like to recommend other people to give it a try.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that online multiplayer can be difficult regarding lobbies, with players getting kicked for having ranks that are either too low or insufficiently low.

citations.review_text:
The OG remaster, the OG gameplay. That's the best AOE version so far (better than IV or DE), the community is still very active, specially for such old game.

That being said , multiplayer stutters happens here and there, and DE version, even though I dislike is the future and multiplayer is much more smooth.

Final review: buy only if it's on a discount.

Great single player, terrible online multiplayer, if you try to join a normal lobby you get kicked for being a low rank and if you join a noob lobby you get kicked for not being low ENOUGH rank. Play alone or play with friends and it's a great time.
